x: Wilf and Anne hope to be visiting England again shortly but in the meantime extend a warm invitation to Belgravians who are promised "an extremely comfortable stay".
But that's not all - they are due on 'Good Morning' with Anne and Nick some time in January. They've only got to get an invite to 'Crinkly Bottom' and they will be outdoing John Regis.

Bruce Barton and Amanda married in Shepperton on 15th July and honeymooned in the USA and the Bahamas, while Nikki Haines, key member of our medal winning London Marathon squad last Spring, married Graeme Neal in Alderney on 27th December. George Flanagan married Anne.
